definitions.explanation: To walk around an area checking for problems or ensuring safety. Used for security guards, police, or anyone conducting inspections.
To move one's eyes around a space to take in the surroundings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}る。
examples.english: The security guard patrols the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: At night, the police patrol the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}って、⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧たち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher walked around the classroom and checked on the students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見回|みまわ}した→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見回|みまわ}して→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦そっと→そっと：03321_sotto⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: He looked around and then quietly stood up from his seat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧{展示室|てんじしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見回|みまわ}した→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧。
examples.english: I slowly looked around the spacious exhibition hall of the museum I was visiting for the first time.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb from ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧. Sense 1 (patrol) typically takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the area being patrolled. Sense 2 (look around) often describes scanning a space with one's eyes rather than physically walking around.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見回|みまわ}る (to patrol a building)
- ⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見回|みまわ}す→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧ (to look around one's surroundings)
- {見回|みまわ}り (patrol — noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{巡回|じゅんかい}→巡回：12407_junkai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make rounds — more formal, used for official patrols
- ⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧: to look out over — implies a wider, panoramic view
